channel.title: The MOBO Awards
channel.desc: A special behind-the-scenes show from the MOBO Awards 2026 at CoOp Live in Manchester. BBC Radio 1 Xtra's DJ Target presents exclusive backstage coverage, including all the glitz and glamour of the red carpet, alongside performances and interviews with the likes of Lauryn Hill, Olivia Dean, Myles Smith, Tiwa Savage, Jamaican dancehall star Shenseea and hip-hop legend Slick Rick.
